rule.name: SecretDigestEquals
rule.message: A password hash or secret digest is compared with equals. PasswordEncoder.encode of a salted encoder (bcrypt, PBKDF2, Argon2) picks a new salt on every call, so its result never equals the stored value: use passwordEncoder.matches(raw, stored). Any other digest, HMAC or crypt(raw, salt) result compared with equals stops at the first differing character and leaks timing: use MessageDigest.isEqual(expected.getBytes(UTF_8), actual.getBytes(UTF_8)). Compare checksums of public data (a file hash, a cache key) with equals.
